svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Retrieval augmented generation on AWS
svg.desc: Retrieval augmented generation on AWS. 10 components in 4 groups. Connections: Users to Amazon Cognito (sign in); Users to Amazon API Gateway (question); Amazon Cognito to Amazon API Gateway (verify token); Amazon API Gateway to RAG agent; RAG agent to Amazon Bedrock (prompt and context); RAG agent to Amazon Bedrock (embed question); RAG agent to Vector index (retrieve); Documents to Ingestion function (ObjectCreated); Ingestion function to Amazon Bedrock (chunks); Ingestion function to Vector index (index); RAG agent to Amazon CloudWatch; Ingestion function to Amazon CloudWatch.

text.tspan: Documents are chunked and embedded into OpenSearch Serverless; an AgentCore agent retrieves context and answers with a Bedrock model
